senses.gloss: (cmp. לוּחַ), to join, or to be joined, be inserted.
to fit, insert; to tenon. Y. Sabb. XII, 13ᶜ המַלְחִים את וכ׳ he who inserts the shutters (of a shop); Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ המלחם (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:12">Cant. R. to V, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:15">ib. to IV, 15</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00343"><he>לְחִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:3">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to the harmonious parallelism of <cite ref="Isaiah 55:7">Is. LV, 7</cite>) <he>כאדם שהוא מלחים שני נסרים ומדביקן זה לזה</he> as one fits (with tenon and mortise) two boards and glues them to one another; <he>כאדם שהוא מ׳ שתי כרעי המטה</he> (leave out <he>ומדביקן זה לזה</he>, v. Ar. s. v. <cite ref="M01521"><he>מלח</he></cite>) as one inserts two legs of a bedstead.
